title: service-push: send through the hosted relay transport (push-relay.zod.ts wire, cloud binding credential)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbacSXJQqAztgt4UMrS

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#29794
Related: objectstack-ai/objectstack#29816 (spec, landed), objectstack-ai/objectstack#29817 (ADR-0012 amendment), objectstack-ai/cloud#3519 (ruling)

## Context

#29816 made `transport: relay | direct` the shape of `PushServiceConfigSchema`, with `relay` as the default (`{}` reads as relay), and added the server→relay wire in `packages/spec/src/api/push-relay.zod.ts`. PR #29794 (round 3) ships `service-push` reading only the `direct` arm. `relay`, including `{}`, is refused loudly at `PushServicePlugin.init` and names this card. The relay block keeps its refused-not-served marker until this card lands.

## Ask

Implement the relay transport in `service-push`:

- **Send.** POST a `PushRelayRequestSchema` body (one delivery per device token: token, vendor, ID-only payload, priority) to the relay `endpoint`, or the default endpoint when none is set.
- **Auth.** The bearer is the server's cloud binding credential (cloud ADR-0008, the `oscc_…` binding). Resolve it through the binding, never inline config, and never log it. No binding means a loud init refusal that names the missing binding.
- **Answers.** Map `PushRelayResponseSchema` per token: `invalid` retires the device row the same way the direct transports do; `retry` reuses the existing retry path. 401 is a loud, non-retryable failure that names the binding.
- **Privacy.** The payload stays ID-only (phase 1). No title or body leaves the server.
- **Flip the refusal.** Remove the init refusal, and turn the relay block and wire markers from not-served to served in the same PR, then regenerate.

## Acceptance

- Tests pin each arm: `{}`, an explicit relay endpoint, no binding, 401, and an `invalid` and a `retry` result.
- Direct-transport behaviour is unchanged.
- The changeset names the newly served relay transport.

Filed by the seat as the follow-up that PR #29794's relay refusal names.
